pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic pre-treatment using an ultrasonic homogeniser (Bandelin-Sonopuls HD 3400) at the frequency of 20 kHz, 70% amplitude and a supplied power of 200 W for 15 minutes.
Ultrasonic pre-treatment using an ultrasonic homogeniser (Bandelin-Sonopuls HD 3400) at the frequency of 20 kHz, 70% amplitude and a supplied power of 200 W for 30 minutes.

Thermal disintegration using a Microwave (MW) Digestion Unit (Berghoff Speedwave MWS-3+) with a staged temperature profile. Applied pressures to reach these temperatures were in the range of 600–2500 kPa. Microwave pre-treatment was applied to the sludge samples for 30 min at 175 °C and 2000 kPa.
